description: Equity Index Data Analyst — Job Description Team Overview — Benchmarks & Indices Operations Equity Index Data Management (EIDM) is part of the Benchmarks & Indices Operations. We are a client-focused, technology-enabled team producing high-value index data for internal and external clients. EIDM owns the underlying reference data used in the calculation of equity index products globally. We maintain LSEG intellectual property by generating and maintaining: ICB Classifications, Free Float, Voting Rights, Nationality, Universe preparation, Liquidity, and similar data points for Index Review, Rebalance, and Reconstitution cycles. Role Purpose We are recruiting an Equity Index Data Analyst for our EIDM team in Bengaluru. Apply and uphold defined Index policies and ground rules to ensure a high degree of data quality and policy compliance. Perform primary research and calculations for: free float, voting rights, shares in issue (total shares outstanding), nationality, industry classification (ICB), country assignment, universe collation, liquidity testing, and IPO set ups. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on data issues and drive action plans that prevent recurrence. description: Job Description Role: Data Analyst II - PDS Location: Bengaluru What You’ll Do We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better. As a Data Analyst II in our data science department, you’ll have the chance to: Be a part of execution of Data science projects and a key player in promoting data assets at MiQ Act as a bridge between raw data and impactful business and product decisions Gain in-depth understanding of media related datasets and ad-tech domain to expand existing insights and create new insights Ensure actionable insights are delivered by utilizing all our rich data in conjunction with source and geo specific data. Who are your stakeholders? The Data Analyst’s Internal Customers / Stakeholders Include Product Management: The Data Analyst works closely with the Product team to help validate frameworks for business impact monitoring through exploration and helping define next steps for insight development. Strong experience with advanced SQL Intermediate experience with Excel / Google Sheets Experience with at-least one programming language - e.g. Python, R Act as a bridge between raw data and impactful business and product decisions by translating data into clear product insights Experience in data pre-processing including (data cleaning, feature creation, anomaly detection and treatment) Experience in delivering data analytics projects leveraging Analytic toolkit (EDA, Data Analysis etc) Continuous improvement and optimization of existing solutions based on evolving product needs with guidance from senior team members Data storytelling to communicate complicated data solutions to non technical stakeholders with guidance Attention to details and ability to timely deliver Comfortable working in agile framework Strong written and verbal communication skills. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ. If you have a passion for the role, please still apply. What impact will you create? The Data Analyst helps scope and validate insights and logics that product wants to expand or build on to drive Ad-Tech solutions that positions MiQ as the leading programmatic partner for advertisers across the lifecycle of a marketing campaign, which consequently contributes to MiQ’s Revenue and Gross Profit. The Data Analyst works closely with other analytics peers and product managers and data scientists to build consumable Product insights that enable key internal stakeholders to discover right audience insights, setup and optimise digital advertising campaigns, and measure the success of these campaigns. The Data Analyst focuses on onboarding new datasets and validating if the right dimensions are captured to build logics on the same, monitoring business impact, and gathering feedback on the data solutions to make sure quality products and features are released to stakeholders. The Data Analyst brings in acute analytical skills to discover patterns and anomalies in the datasets, and help make informed decisions when it comes to development and data partnerships What’s in it for you? Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business. They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do - no matter how big or small. We do what we love - Passion We figure it out - Determination We anticipate the unexpected - Agility We always unite - Unite We dare to be unconventional - Courage Benefits Every region and office has specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect: A hybrid work environment New hire orientation with job-specific onboarding and training Internal and global mobility opportunities Competitive healthcare benefits Bonus and performance incentives Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives. Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities Apply today! Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Business Data Analyst
description: Job Title: Business Data Analyst Location: Bangalore Experience: 8+ Years About the role: Latinum is looking for an experienced Business Data Analyst for a client to drive end-to-end delivery of enterprise data, analytics, and reporting initiatives. The role involves partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyse business processes and datasets, assess solution feasibility, and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications. You will work closely with Data Engineering and BI teams to deliver scalable data solutions on Azure, covering the complete SDLC from requirement gathering to deployment and production support. Key Responsibilities Engage with business stakeholders across multiple domains to gather, analyse, challenge, and document business requirements through workshops and discovery sessions. Perform business process analysis, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), and gap analysis to validate business rules, identify data quality issues, and define future-state solutions. Assess functional and technical feasibility, implementation approaches, dependencies, risks, and solution options. Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, process flows, business rules, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and project documentation. Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering and BI teams. Collaborate with Data Engineers throughout the SDLC to clarify requirements, track implementation, resolve functional issues, and ensure successful delivery. Write and optimise SQL queries on Azure Synapse and Salesforce staging data for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards, reports, and DAX measures for enterprise reporting and KPI tracking. Define and validate requirements for data integrations, reporting, automation, and data quality improvements. Coordinate SIT and UAT, manage defects, validate acceptance criteria, and obtain stakeholder sign-off. Support production deployments and post-production hypercare, coordinating issue resolution between business and technical teams. Maintain KPI definitions, data dictionaries, governance artefacts, and reporting standards while managing multiple initiatives. Required Skills & Experience 8+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Enterprise Reporting within large or complex organisations. Proven experience managing end-to-end requirements and delivery across discovery, analysis, documentation, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Strong expertise in business process analysis, EDA, gap analysis, and technical feasibility assessments. Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in Azure Synapse Analytics or equivalent MPP/cloud data warehouse platforms. Advanced Power BI skills, including semantic modelling, DAX, dashboard development, and enterprise reporting. Good understanding of relational databases, ETL/ELT concepts, data modelling, source-to-target mappings, and data governance. Experience translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering teams. Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with Data Engineering teams. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting. Strong documentation skills, including BRDs, FRDs, process flows, and testing artefacts. Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, facilitation, and problem-solving skills. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field. Preferred Industry Experience Real Estate industry experience is preferred but not mandatory. Ideal Candidate: A strong Business Data Analyst who combines business requirements ownership, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, Azure data platform exposure, and end-to-end SDLC delivery experience.
